item.title: Small Living Room Storage for Renters: A Layout-First Plan
item.description: Quick answer: keep a clear walking path of about 36 inches, put a low console with closed storage under the TV and anchor it, use one wall shelf above it for light items, let the coffee table hold a single basket, and run every cord to one uncovered power strip. Most other things belong in another room. Why Small Living Rooms Fill Up So Fast A living room is the one room that does everything.
